CodeLoading.description:
A value that loads code or configuration (dev-env §15.3 req. 16): `field` is a dotted
path, `params.<name>`, `workflow.location`, or `engine.<option>` for an engine option of
`spectio.toml`; `writable_by_others` when the path, or a directory above it, is.
CodeLoading.title: CodeLoading

Command.description:
The engine command as the head script runs it (P1 Task 30): `text` is `argv` quoted for a
POSIX shell, and names the parameters file, never a value.
Command.title: Command

Efficiency.description:
A job's CPU and memory efficiency (schedulers §3.6), `cpu` and `mem` ratios, never
clamped; `peak_rss_bytes` and `elapsed_s` the values they come from.
Efficiency.title: Efficiency

EngineSettings.description:
What the engine said of its temporary files (P1 Task 34): Nextflow's `cleanup`;
Snakemake's `--notemp`, null in 0.0.1 (no event carries it).
EngineSettings.title: EngineSettings

Environment.description: A definition: a snapshot's fields and the default profile of each engine.
Environment.title: Environment

EnvironmentItem.description:
One environment of `GET /environments` (FU-P3-86d, api §5.4): a built-in or one of the
file's; `usable: false` with its reason, such as a SLURM one on a local server.
EnvironmentItem.title: EnvironmentItem

Failure.description:
A job that failed on its last attempt (P1 Task 29); `log_tail` is the last 20 lines of
its log, escape sequences removed, or null when it could not be read. `work_dir` is the
directory the job files listing shows, for the failure summary's Copy (P1 Task 32).
Failure.title: Failure

Head.description:
The last launch's head; `session` is null for a run started from a terminal, whose head
is `checked` only when its pointer's boot ID is the server's (architecture §13.8).
Head.title: Head

LaunchTemplate.description:
A `POST /runs` body prefilled from a run, for Copy to a new launch (P1 Task 30), with the
parameters that differ from the pipeline's defaults and the values that load code.
LaunchTemplate.title: LaunchTemplate

LocalValues.description: The most the tasks may request at once; the user's cgroup stays the only hard cap.
LocalValues.title: LocalValues

ProcessEfficiency.description: Over the last attempts of its tasks (schedulers §3.6): ratios, 0.63 for 63 %.
ProcessEfficiency.title: ProcessEfficiency

RelaunchIn.description: The body of `:relaunch` (api §5.1); 0.0.1 takes `mode: resume` alone.
RelaunchIn.title: RelaunchIn

Requested.description: The most common request of the jobs; `varies` when they differ.
Requested.title: Requested

Resources.description:
Requested (`cpus`, `memory_bytes`, `time_s`) and measured values of the task's last
attempt; `source` names where the measures come from (P1 Task 29). Unknown: null.
Resources.title: Resources

ResultEntry.description:
One entry of a results folder (P1 Task 31): a folder's `size` is null, and so are both
for a `link_outside`; `mtime` is ISO 8601.
ResultEntry.title: ResultEntry

ResultStat.description:
The listing's entry for one results path (api §5.3), with the root and the path the
server answered for.
ResultStat.title: ResultStat

Results.description: One folder of a run's results directory, and the reports found below its root.
Results.title: Results

RunEnvironment.description:
The run's own environment, as resolved at launch (FU-P3-86a, api §5.4); its fields are
null unless `state` is `recorded`.
RunEnvironment.title: RunEnvironment

Scheduler.description:
What the scheduler said of a failed job (P1 Task 29): its state and reason, from `sacct`
or the engine's own message, and requested and used memory and time, from `sacct` or the
trace. `accounting` says whether `sacct` answered, is being asked, or is unavailable (off,
not on SLURM, no job ID, or no answer).
Scheduler.title: Scheduler

Slurm.description: `custom_options`: `slurm_extra` or `clusterOptions` was set, the text never kept.
Slurm.title: Slurm

SlurmAllocated.description: What SLURM gave the job, from `sacct` once it ended.
SlurmAllocated.title: SlurmAllocated

SlurmRequest.description: What the engine asked SLURM for (api §5 note of 2026-11-07).
SlurmRequest.title: SlurmRequest

TaskFile.description: One file of an attempt (P1 Task 28): `size` and `mtime` (ISO 8601) only when `present`.
TaskFile.title: TaskFile

TaskOutput.description: One output of a Snakemake job's `job_info`: `tbd` for a checkpoint's `<TBD>`.
TaskOutput.title: TaskOutput

WorkDir.description:
One folder of a Nextflow attempt's work directory (api §5.3, FU-P3-85e): the results
listing without `reports`, names that start with `.` hidden.
WorkDir.title: WorkDir

The ticket was already used, has expired or is unknown

get.description: Newest first by `created_at`, or by `ended_at` (`sort=-ended_at`: ended runs only).

get.description:
One item per process or rule in first-seen order (ui-spec §4.4): for Snakemake the rules
by their first job, then those the freeze recorded in the rule files' order (FU-P3-107);
for Nextflow those the projector recorded (`onProcessCreate`, a first task), in that order;
then any known from tasks only (a database from before P1 Task 27), in their first task's
order. Each keeps the stage it froze with.
Each has its `status`, the `efficiency` of its jobs (P1 Task 34), and its `pipeline_order`
(FU-P3-82).
